headline_marked: Zafar Iqbal, ex-DU VC among 8 [[formal charges filed against them]] at ICT-1
headline: Zafar Iqbal, ex-DU VC among 8 formal charges filed against them at ICT-1
summary: The charges relate to alleged crimes against humanity during the July Uprising, including incitement and conspiracy to attack protesters on the DU campus.
details: The prosecution has submitted formal charges to the registrar's office of International Crimes Tribunal-1 against eight individuals, including former Dhaka University Vice-Chancellor ASM Maksud Kamal and academic Dr. Muhammad Zafar Iqbal.

The other accused include DU Professor AKM Jamal Uddin, retired Appellate Division Justice AHM Shamsuddin Chowdhury Manik, and BCL President Saddam Hussain and General Secretary Sheikh Wali Asif Enan.
Additionally, DU unit BCL President Mazharul Kabir Shayan and General Secretary Tanbir Hasan Shaikat are among those charged.
Prosecutor Gazi Monawar Hossain Tamim stated that the charges involve allegations of incitement, conspiracy, attempt, and abetment in connection with attacks on protesters on the university campus.

The prosecution alleges that former VC Maksud Kamal made provocative statements and was involved in conspiracies that led to attacks on protesters by Chhatra League, Jubo League activists, and police.
Currently, Justice Manik, Professor Jamal, and Tanbir Hasan Shaikat are in custody, while the other accused individuals are absconding.
caption:
Formal charges have been filed against former DU VC and Zafar Iqbal for alleged crimes against humanity during the July Uprising.

The prosecution has submitted formal charges to the registrar's office of International Crimes Tribunal-1 against eight individuals, including former Dhaka University Vice-Chancellor ASM Maksud Kamal and academic Dr. Muhammad Zafar Iqbal.

The other accused include DU Professor AKM Jamal Uddin, retired Appellate Division Justice AHM Shamsuddin Chowdhury Manik, and BCL President Saddam Hussain and General Secretary Sheikh Wali Asif Enan.

Additionally, DU unit BCL President Mazharul Kabir Shayan and General Secretary Tanbir Hasan Shaikat are among those charged.

Prosecutor Gazi Monawar Hossain Tamim stated that the charges involve allegations of incitement, conspiracy, attempt, and abetment in connection with attacks on protesters on the university campus.

The prosecution alleges that former VC Maksud Kamal made provocative statements and was involved in conspiracies that led to attacks on protesters by Chhatra League, Jubo League activists, and police.

Currently, Justice Manik, Professor Jamal, and Tanbir Hasan Shaikat are in custody, while the other accused individuals are absconding.

headline: Dengue claims 7 lives in 24 hours; 1,753 hospitalized nationwide
summary: The dengue outbreak continues to claim lives, with 7 deaths reported in the last 24 hours. Over 1,700 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country.
details: The Directorate General of Health Services reported that 7 people died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours. During the same period, 1,753 new dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh.

According to a dengue update released on Wednesday (September 16) by the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room, the admitted patients were spread across various divisions, including 186 in Barisal, 177 in Chittagong, and 349 in Khulna.

The Dhaka metropolitan area saw significant numbers, with 175 patients admitted to Dhaka North City Corporation hospitals and 174 to Dhaka South City Corporation hospitals. Other divisions also reported new admissions: Mymensingh (183), Rajshahi (153), Rangpur (53), and Sylhet (9).
This brings the total number of dengue deaths this year to 171. In total, 56,916 people have been admitted to hospitals with dengue across the country this year.
